source_chain: CJ_ReadRemoteObjectArray reads a count from nativeParcel_ then allocates and fills typed arrays
wrapper_route_assessment.what_this_establishes: The exported Cangjie FFI wrapper binds a MessageSequenceImpl handle to the vulnerable parser helper. The official ipc_ffi.h declares the exported function.
wrapper_route_assessment.what_remains_unknown: The reviewed source does not establish an attacker-controlled local Binder route to this FFI handle, product build inclusion, exact parcel byte accounting, or information disclosure by this precise path. The CVE bulletin establishes the official component-level issue and impact label, but this source check is not a product route proof.
wrapper_route_assessment.current_b_ipc_root_fit: The ohscanner.interface.ipc implementation roots most IPC analysis in source-confirmed OnRemoteRequest dispatchers or explicit service/transport allowlist roots. This CJ FFI binding is a public language/runtime wrapper and the target is a reusable parcel parser helper; it is not itself an OnRemoteRequest dispatcher. The present detector also has no count-derived allocation-size versus indexed element-width rule.
